faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the RDPD Ramanathapuram Record Clerk recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the RDPD Ramanathapuram Record Clerk recruitment is 30 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the department before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for the Record Clerk post?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit for the Record Clerk post is 18 years, and the maximum age limit is 37 years. Age relaxation is provided for certain categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Record Clerk position?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed the 10th standard (Matriculation) from a recognized board or institution to be eligible for the Record Clerk post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Record Clerk post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Record Clerk post will receive a salary in the pay scale of Rs. 15900 to Rs. 58600 per month, as per Pay Level-02.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the RDPD Ramanathapuram Record Clerk job?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. Candidates need to download the application form from the official website, fill it correctly, attach necessary documents, and send it via post to the specified address before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this RDPD Ramanathapuram Record Clerk recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Record Clerk role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Record Clerk position will involve an Interview and Document Verification. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their performance in these stages.

faq.question: Q8. Which department is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by the Rural Development and Panchayat Raj Department Ramanathapuram (RDPD Ramanathapuram).

faq.question: Q9. What is the total number of vacancies for the Record Clerk post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Record Clerk post announced in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of the Rural Development and Panchayat Raj Department Ramanathapuram, which is https://ramanathapuram.nic.in.
